title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: search and query Dataverse business data with Business Applications in Work IQ
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap and tenant notice are reported accurately, and the documented controls, licensing and billing support its guidance. Microsoft pages disagree about whether Business Applications access in Copilot Studio is generally available or preview; the briefing should report that disagreement and cite the additional reference supporting its Dataverse action syntax.
